newsitem.title: CHINA: HK Telecom hits high on China rumours.
newsitem.headline: HK Telecom hits high on China rumours.

text.p: Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd shares hit a new year high on Friday on rumours of a share placement to a mainland Chinese investor, market sources said.
Hongkong Telecom shares were up HK$1.15 at HK$20.25 at midday. They hit a year high of HK$20.30 in morning trade, breaking the previous record of HK$19.70.

Traders said the shares were rising on rumours Britain's Cable & Wireless would place about four percent of Hongkong Telecom with China Everbright Holdings Co Ltd, which is controlled by China's State Council, or cabinet.
An arm of China Everbright Holdings paid CITIC Pacific Ltd HK$12.60 a share for 7.74 percent of Hongkong Telecom in May.
Last month, another Chinese agency, China Telecom (Hong Kong) Ltd, paid C&W HK$14.25 a share for 5.5 percent of Hongkong Telecom.
C&W holds just under 54 percent of Hongkong Telecom.
